what: quiet_init before argparse conflicts with the plan's help and usage contracts
scenario_or_breakage: After quiet_init redirects fd1 and fd2, argparse --help stdout and error usage stderr go to the quiet log, not caller-visible streams, so the proposed argparse tests either fail or must disable quiet and miss the real path
suggested_fix: Move quiet_init after argparse help/error handling, or route argparse help/errors explicitly to the saved caller-visible streams; run these tests without LARCH_QUIET_DISABLE
